research.title: OpenStax College Physics2e §2.3 Time, Velocity, and Speed
research.read: Actual primary HTML: elapsed time, path/elapsed average speed vs displacement/elapsed velocity, return journey distinction.
research.licence: Actual preface https://openstax.org/books/college-physics-2e/pages/preface lines25–34 states CC BY-NC-SA4.0, not blanket CC BY. Third-party art has separate credits. No source prose/figures/code reused.
research.adopted: Distinguish totalpath and displacement; keep stops in elapsed time. Original Finnish finite examples and diagrams; no efficacy transfer.

research.title: OpenStax College Physics2e §2.4 Acceleration
research.read: Actual primary HTML: change in velocity over elapsed time, direction, and negative acceleration need not reduce speed.
research.licence: Same actual preface CC BY-NC-SA4.0 with art exceptions. Conceptual comparison only; no copied figures or long passages.
research.adopted: Compare equal-time changes and braking; scope signed1D model, distinguish direction from speed magnitude. No claims about child outcomes.

research.title: NIST SP811 §4 SI derived units
research.read: Actual primary HTML Table2 and derivation discussion: m/s and m/s². Policy https://www.nist.gov/open/license also retrieved.
research.licence: NIST employee non-SRD works generally not US-copyright, foreign/third-party/SRD qualifications and acknowledgment rules apply. No source art or text copied; dimensional facts independently derived.
research.adopted: Length/time and velocity/time dimensions; no claim that a source validates local rendering or learning effectiveness.

planning.teacherObjective: Tunnistaa nopeuden muutoksen ja muuttumattomuuden, myös jarrutuksen; tulkitsee tasaisen nopeusmuutoksen sekuntia kohti ilmoitetulla yksiulotteisella mallilla.
planning.scope: Finite original1D models only; signed velocity and integrated totalpath. Exact closed-form state independent of frame rate. Constant acceleration bounds SI only; piecewiseconstant speed with explicit units. Supported labels/kinds/fields/ranges fail closed, no descriptor defaults. Rawdecimal input <=128chars, <=6 meaningful fractional digits, equivalent zeros/comma/dot accepted, no expression/rounding oracle.
planning.sourceVsDesign: Frozen curriculum labels inherited, not fresh Finnish official curriculum approval. Primary concept comparison does not establish lesson efficacy.
planning.evidenceLimits: No formal learnerhistory, physical measurement, oral demonstration or independent process/rubric claim.
